content: DEFLATE parallel decompression fundamentals: the bitstream is inherently serial; parallel decode requires either sync-flush markers (pigz/BGZF files), gzip member boundaries (concatenated members), or pugz-style two-pass speculative decode (find stored-block LEN/NLEN patterns, probe-decode to confirm, split with a 32KB window prefix); standard single-member gzip without markers gains little; pigz itself does NOT parallelize decompression of standard gzip.
